market_outlook.short_term: Highly volatile. CPI print is the dominant catalyst — a hot print could push 10Y past 5%, trigger equity correction, and accelerate oil-driven inflation fears. Oil above $100 sustains energy outperformance. Bessent's yen credibility crisis adds FX noise. Expect 5-8% equity drawdown risk if CPI exceeds 3.5% YoY.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds in AI infrastructure, energy transition, and GLP-1 therapeutics remain intact. However, persistent oil premium and trade fragmentation cap multiple expansion. 6-12 month view: selective outperformance in energy, defense, AI infrastructure, and healthcare; underperformance in consumer discretionary, EM, and high-multiple tech.
